## Setup

```r
library(tidyverse)     # dplyr, ggplot2, readr, tidyr, stringr, forcats
library(gtsummary)

students <- read_csv("data/meded_students.csv")
osce     <- read_csv("data/osce_stations.csv")
```

## Look at your data

| Function | Shows |
|---|---|
| `glimpse(df)` | Types and first values, use this most |
| `str(df)` | Structure, base R version |
| `head(df, 10)` | First rows |
| `names(df)` | Column names |
| `nrow(df)` / `ncol(df)` | Dimensions |
| `summary(df)` | Descriptives per column |
| `count(df, var)` | Frequency table |
| `skimr::skim(df)` | Everything, prettily |

## dplyr

```r
df |> filter(score > 70, sex == "Female")   # rows; comma = AND
df |> filter(batch %in% c("2023", "2024"))  # set membership
df |> select(id, score, arm)                # columns
df |> select(starts_with("q"))              # helpers
df |> arrange(desc(score))                  # sort
df |> mutate(pct = 100 * score / max_score) # new column
df |> rename(new_name = old_name)
df |> distinct()                            # drop duplicate rows
df |> slice_head(n = 5)

df |>
  group_by(arm) |>
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    mean = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(score,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### Conditional recoding

```r
df |> mutate(pass = if_else(score >= 50, "Yes", "No"))

df |> mutate(band = case_when(
  score >= 75 ~ "Distinction",
  score >= 50 ~ "Pass",
  .default    = "Fail"
))
```

### Joins and reshaping

```r
left_join(a, b, by = "student_id")     # keep all of a
inner_join(a, b, by = "student_id")    # keep matches only

long  |> pivot_wider(names_from = domain, values_from = score)
wide  |> pivot_longer(cols = q1:q5, names_to = "item", values_to = "response")
```

Always check `nrow()` after a join.

## ggplot2

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = var1, y = var2, colour = group)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ site) +
  labs(title = "...", x = "...", y = "...", colour = "...") +
  theme_minimal()
```

| Geom | For |
|---|---|
| `geom_histogram(binwidth = 5)` | One continuous variable |
| `geom_density()` | Smoothed distribution |
| `geom_boxplot()` | Continuous by category |
| `geom_jitter(width = .15, alpha = .3)` | Raw points on top of a boxplot |
| `geom_point()` | Two continuous variables |
| `geom_smooth(method = "lm")` | Fitted line |
| `geom_col()` | Bars from values you computed |
| `geom_bar()` | Bars from counts R computes |

```r
ggsave("output/fig1.png", width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

Remember: **inside `aes()` = mapped to a variable; outside = fixed.**

## gtsummary

```r
df |>
  select(arm, age, sex, score) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = arm,
    label     = list(age ~ "Age (years)"),
    statistic = all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
    digits    = all_continuous() ~ 1,
    missing   = "ifany"
  ) |>
  add_p() |>
  add_overall() |>
  bold_labels() |>
  modify_caption("**Table 1.** Characteristics.")

lm(score ~ arm + age, data = df) |>
  tbl_regression(exponentiate = FALSE) |>
  add_glance_table(include = c(nobs, r.squared))
```

## Quarto

````markdown
---
title: "My analysis"
format:
  html: {toc: true}
  docx: default
execute: {echo: false, warning: false}
---

```{{r}}
#| label: fig-gain
#| fig-cap: "Gain by arm."
#| echo: false
```

Mean gain was `r knitr::inline_expr("round(mean(df$gain, na.rm = TRUE), 1)")`.
See @fig-gain.
````

| Chunk option | Effect |
|---|---|
| `echo: false` | Hide code |
| `eval: false` | Don't run |
| `include: false` | Run silently |
| `fig-cap:` / `tbl-cap:` | Captions |
| `label: fig-x` / `tbl-x` | Cross-references |

## Keyboard shortcuts

| Shortcut | Does |
|---|---|
| <kbd>Ctrl/Cmd</kbd> + <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Run current line |
| <kbd>Ctrl/Cmd</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>K</kbd> | Render |
| <kbd>Ctrl/Cmd</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>F10</kbd> | Restart R |
| <kbd>Alt</kbd> + <kbd>-</kbd> | Insert `<-` |
| <kbd>Ctrl/Cmd</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>M</kbd> | Insert the native pipe |
| <kbd>Ctrl/Cmd</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>C</kbd> | Comment / uncomment |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Autocomplete |
| <kbd>Ctrl/Cmd</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>P</kbd> | Command palette |
